title: fix: run the code agent redeploy after the enter secret push
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the duplicate `Setup SOPS` step added in #15008; the second setup-sops fails with `EEXIST` on the tool symlink and failed the enter job of production run 35124478906 (agents were already redeployed 5/5 before that step)
- Moves `Redeploy code agents` after `Push enter secrets`, reusing the existing SOPS setup

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Secrets Before the Swarm
gist.blurb: The deployment garden now packs its enter secrets before sending the code agents back to work. One duplicate SOPS setup step has also stopped trying to install itself twice.
gist.summary: The production Cloudflare deployment workflow now pushes enter secrets before redeploying code agents, while removing a duplicate Setup SOPS step that failed on an existing tool symlink.
gist.impact: Production deploys can complete the enter-secret update and code-agent redeploy sequence reliably without the duplicate SOPS installation interrupting the job.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy deployment garden: Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, carefully places a glowing secret packet into an enter gateway before a small group of eager code-agent sprites walk down a garden path to their freshly prepared workstations. A single SOPS toolbox sits neatly nearby, representing the reused setup step and orderly deployment sequence.
